note: Shared source of truth for the kids trigger: the server (askchat_safety.py), web and TV all port this regex and assert these vectors. A match sets the kids chip. Phrases askParse reads as kids but that never set it on their own (works for all/everyone, all ages, whole family) are negatives here, and a parser-produced kids chip triggered only by them is dropped unless a real trigger also matches.
regex: \b(?:(?<!\bno )(?<!\bnot )(?<!\bwithout )with (?:my|the|our) (?:(?!(?:no|not|without|since|because|while|but|or|of)\b)[\w'-]+ ){0,3}(?:kids?|children|son|daughter|toddler|grandkids?|nephews?|nieces?|little ones)(?! of\b)(?!-in-law)|(?<!\bno )(?<!\bnot )(?<!\bwithout )with (?:an?|my|our) (?:(?!(?:no|not|without|since|because|while|but|or|of)\b)[\w'-]+ ){0,2}(?:[1-9]|1[0-4])[- ]?(?:year|yr)s?[- ]?olds?|me and (?:my|the|our) (?:(?!(?:no|not|without|since|because|while|but|or|of)\b)[\w'-]+ ){0,3}(?:kids?|children|son|daughter|toddler|grandkids?|nephews?|nieces?|little ones)(?! of\b)(?!-in-law)|(?:my|the|our) (?:(?!(?:no|not|without|since|because|while|but|or|of)\b)[\w'-]+ ){0,2}(?:kids?|children|toddler|grandkids?) and (?:i|me)|for (?:(?:the )?(?:kids|family|children)|(?:my|our) (?:family|little ones|kids?|children|toddler|grandkids?|(?:son|daughter)(?!-in-law)))|(?:kids|children) are watching|(?:my|our|the) (?:kids|children) are here|(?:[1-9]|1[0-4])[- ]?(?:year|yr)s?[- ]?olds? (?:is|are) watching|family (?:movie|night|film))\b
semantics: case-insensitive search (not anchored) over the user's text; \w is ASCII [A-Za-z0-9_]; a match sets the kids chip

notes.kids movie I watched as a child?: decided NOT a trigger: it is a retrospective title query; askParse's own 'kids' word still reads it as a kids chip in the parse
notes.something that works for everyone at the: NOT a trigger: 'works for all/everyone' would cap adult requests (askParse alone still reads it as kids)
notes.a film about my family's history: NOT a trigger: 'about', not 'for'; only `for (the )?(kids|family|children)` and `for (my|our) family` match
notes.all ages: NOT a trigger on its own (like works for all/everyone and whole family)
notes.a film with the son of Kirk Douglas: NOT a trigger: `of` stops the filler and the noun is not followed by ` of`
notes.a biopic of my son's hero: NOT a trigger: a possessive mention alone, without with/for/are watching, is not read as kids present
notes.with my husband and two kids: `and` is not a filler stopper: 'with my wife and kids' IS a trigger (the unsafe direction)
notes.ages: ages 1-14 by design; 15-17 not treated as kids
